en: Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1` for Claude apps gateways: with `oidc.use_proxy: true`, sign-in requests hand the proxy an `https` IdP's hostname even with `NO_PROXY` set
zh: 新增 Claude 应用网关的 `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_IDP_CONNECT_BY_HOSTNAME=1`：配合 `oidc.use_proxy: true` 时，即使设置了 `NO_PROXY`，登录请求也会把 `https` IdP 的主机名交给代理
